BiblicalUsage: Beth-Hoglah means "house of the partridge." It was a place in Benjamin on the border with Judah. It turns up in Joshua 15:6, Joshua 18:19 and Joshua 18:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beth-Hoglah marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
